name: flash-keep-awake
title: SSD Mode
summary: Keeps flash storage on for a time that you select after each use.
description: Makes songs start faster on an iPod with flash storage.
details: The iPod keeps the storage on after each use, for the time that you select. The default is 30 minutes. The Apple firmware switches it off after 1 second.
When the iPod wakes from sleep, it starts the storage immediately.
Thus the storage is ready when you choose a song.
Before the iPod switches off the storage, it waits 0.5 seconds. This gives the flash card time to complete its writes.
requires: Flash storage, for example an iFlash, CompactFlash or SSD adapter. Do not use this patch with the original hard drive.
notes: For the fastest start after a long pause, also turn on Wake Storage on Input. Set the same Storage Time in the two patches.
hdd_warning: This patch is for flash storage. On the original hard drive, it keeps the disk turning for the selected time after each use. This uses more battery and causes more wear.

choices.title: 1 minute
choices.description: The storage stops soon after each use. This uses the least battery. The first song after a pause can start late.

choices.title: 2 minutes
choices.description: The storage stops soon after each use. The first song after a pause can start late.

choices.title: 5 minutes
choices.description: A balance of battery use and fast starts.

choices.title: 10 minutes
choices.description: A balance of battery use and fast starts.

choices.title: 30 minutes
choices.description: The default. Songs start fast after most pauses.

choices.title: 60 minutes
choices.description: Songs start fast after long pauses. This uses the most battery.
